title: Step along a direction
prompt: The robot at position moves step units along direction, which already has length 1. Return the new position. From (0, 0) along (1, 0) by 5 is (5, 0).
starter:
func solve(position, direction, step) -> Vector2:
	return position
hints: Scale the direction by the step, then add it to the position.

docs.name: a + b, a - b, v * number, v / number
docs.what: Vectors add and subtract part by part, and scale by a plain number.

solution:
func solve(position, direction, step) -> Vector2:
	return position + direction * step
